_comment: The works hanging in LUMEN, with the credit line each one must display.
EVERY image in this file must be public domain, from a museum open-access
collection, with its credit line recorded here and rendered on the wall
label. The course outline treats plagiarism seriously and 'we found it on
Google Images' is the wrong answer in a viva.
The placeholder-* entries are generated by tools/make-placeholder-assets.py
and are our own work. Replace them as you source real images.
